channel.description: Latest articles from The Highland Times (thehighlandtimes.com)

item.title: No New Local Growth Fund Allocation for Highlands and Islands Partnership
item.description: Moray Council has expressed disappointment after confirmation that the Highlands and Islands Regional Economic Partnership will receive no funding from the new Local Growth Fund replacing the UK Shared Prosperity Fund.The post No New Local Growth Fund Allocation for Highlands and Islands Partnership appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Lays Amendment to Block Whisky Tax Rise at Westminster
item.description: The SNP has lodged an amendment at Westminster to block a planned whisky tax rise, challenging Scottish Labour MPs to back the move and warning of further damage to Scotland’s world class whisky industry.The post SNP Lays Amendment to Block Whisky Tax Rise at Westminster appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Study Finds Signs of Recovery for Critically Endangered Flapper Skate in Scottish Waters
item.description: New research drawing on fishers’ experience has found growing evidence that critically endangered flapper skate are beginning to recover in Scottish waters, with protection measures showing early signs of success.The post Study Finds Signs of Recovery for Critically Endangered Flapper Skate in Scottish Waters appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: MSP Calls for Permanent MRI Scanner at Dr Gray’s Hospital
item.description: Moray MSP Richard Lochhead is calling for a permanent MRI scanner at Dr Gray’s Hospital after hundreds of patients avoided long journeys to Aberdeen thanks to a temporary mobile unit.The post MSP Calls for Permanent MRI Scanner at Dr Gray’s Hospital appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Overnight Traffic Management Planned on A9 and B9154 Near Moy
item.description: Overnight traffic management will be in place on the A9 and B9154 near Moy from 13 to 16 January as essential works are carried out, with temporary signals, lane closures and a 30mph speed limit in operation.The post Overnight Traffic Management Planned on A9 and B9154 Near Moy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Budget Sets Out Major Investment in NHS, Cost of Living Support and Infrastructure
item.description: The Scottish Government’s 2026 to 27 Budget sets out record investment in the NHS, cost of living support for families, child poverty measures and major infrastructure funding across Scotland.The post Scottish Budget Sets Out Major Investment in NHS, Cost of Living Support and Infrastructure appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Munro Welcomes Scottish Budget Prioritising Support for Families, Local Businesses and NHS
item.description: SNP candidate Eilidh Munro has welcomed the Scottish Government’s £68 billion Budget, saying its focus on families, NHS investment, social care and local business support offers real ambition for the Highlands amid continued cost of living pressures.The post Munro Welcomes Scottish Budget Prioritising Support for Families, Local Businesses and NHS appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: NFU Scotland Warns Budget Flatlines Support for Farmers and Crofters
item.description: NFU Scotland has warned the 2026 to 27 Scottish Budget flatlines support for farmers and crofters, offering short term certainty but failing to match rising costs and the growing demands placed on rural communities.The post NFU Scotland Warns Budget Flatlines Support for Farmers and Crofters appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Lulu, Kirsty Wark and Alan Cumming to Launch Pitlochry Festival Theatre’s 75th Anniversary Appeal
item.description: Pitlochry Festival Theatre launches its 75th anniversary appeal with Lulu, Kirsty Wark, Alan Cumming and a free costume exhibition, marking a major cultural moment as the Highland theatre looks boldly towards its future.The post Lulu, Kirsty Wark and Alan Cumming to Launch Pitlochry Festival Theatre’s 75th Anniversary Appeal appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scotland Commits £30 Billion to Infrastructure Investment by 2030
item.description: Scotland has unveiled plans to invest £30 billion in infrastructure by 2030, backing housing, transport, the NHS, climate resilience and Highland connectivity as part of the 2026-27 Budget and long-term Spending Review.The post Scotland Commits £30 Billion to Infrastructure Investment by 2030 appeared first on The Highland Times.
